# Hurricane Helene: interruption report draft under S.C. Code Ann. Regs. 103-314 (Interruption of Service)

Synthetic data: Helene replay on the SGW synthetic network. Draft, not filed.

Rule: S.C. Code Ann. Regs. 103-314 (Interruption of Service). SC PSC electric rules, ch. 103 art. 3 (copy dated Oct 2024). The rule asks for a record of time, duration and cause, notice to the Commission and the ORS as soon as practicable, and a complete report after restoration for an interruption longer than 6 hours.

## Summary

Hurricane Helene interrupted service to 522,448 customers in the South Carolina service area from 2024-09-26 21:30Z until the last damaged section was back at 2024-10-04 11:26Z (181.9 h). 43 of 43 affected counties were interrupted for more than 6 hours; the longest was SC-45083 (SPAS) at 174.4 h. Cause: Hurricane Helene: wind and tree damage to distribution sections (peak gust at a damaged section 49 m/s; damage states: complete 37, extensive 121, moderate 292, slight 628).
